name: Aarav Patel
story: Standing at 11,570 ft with Mt. Trishul right in front of our eyes at sunrise was an unforgettable spiritual awakening. Kailasa Trails guides were world-class!

name: Pooja Reddy
story: Sub-zero alpine push at 2 AM under shooting stars. Reached the summit right as the Swargarohini peak caught first alpenglow.

name: Vikram Mehra
story: Crossing the knifedge ridge at 16,200 ft with ropes was thrilling. Rented all winter gear from Kailasa Trails, top notch quality!
